Current setting: τaff=0.05 m, using strict absolute-change greater-than comparison.
ϵprior=10−10 m applied to the largest partition total; no mapped input also returns no scores.
αcent=0.5. Both centroid matching and individual-fingerprint matching use Eq. (SM25).
ϵmatch=10−10 m; norms below it are omitted.

Use supplied state when present; otherwise rank/fingerprint search falls back to all currently supplied numerical templates. Each missing partition–state centroid falls back to that partition’s cross-state mean.
Two successive sorting operations assign distinct ordinal ranks; no average ranks are assigned to ties, and zero-norm templates are retained.
The default retrieval depth is 10. Lrank=10; Lfp=20; Lsem=20. The latter two are twice the default depth.
Every retained scenario vote is weighted by reciprocal result rank, 1/r, using that channel’s score.

Divide each nonempty channel by its maximum positive partition score; absent/nonpositive channels contribute zero. No minimum subtraction and no renormalization of the weights when a channel is unavailable.
τF,1=0.1 m and τF,2=1.0 m, applied to δ=maxℓ|yℓ|.
λgraph=0.15. One row-normalized adjacency aggregation is applied, without convergence iterations or a sum-to-one probability normalization.

The numerical output contains Top-3 and Top-5 label lists and up to ten final scores. Stored score values are rounded to four decimals; ranking and the confidence gap are calculated before this output rounding.
